mechanism.name: verified binding declarative skill DAG
mechanism.adaptation: FCA-side bounded composer outside the connectome controller

checks: FAP V86 composes only pre-registered verified deterministic side-effect-free bindings
FAP V86 uses declarative DAGs rather than generated source code
FAP V86 rejects cycles, dead nodes and graphs above 12 nodes
FAP V86 gates promotion with unit, boundary, deterministic replay and shadow holdouts
FAP V86 dedicated workflow includes V78-V86 regression targets on Python 3.11 and 3.12

constraints: does not alter FCA connectome sensing, sparse KC activation, MBON competition, reward plasticity or action selection
does not generate, import or eval source code
bindings must be host-provided and already verified, deterministic and side-effect-free
maximum 12 nodes; graph must be acyclic and every node must contribute to the output
this bounded adaptation does not import FAP V86's autonomous invention or sparse-routing bridge
